messages.subject: Re: Masalin input data
messages.body_plain:
Hi all - thanks for checking in Maria; I've CCed in the MaAsLin users group, who should be able to help out as well.  MaAsLin folks, can you help tackle this?

Thanks a bunch -
Curtis

On Fri, Nov 13, 2015 at 5:17 AM, Maria Glymenaki <maria.g...@manchester.ac.uk> wrote:
> Dear Dr Huttenhower and Dr Subramanian,
>
> I have been using the MaAsLin tool on Galaxy run by your laboratory .I have already sent you some emails about questions I had using Masalin. I would appreciate it if you could clarify to me if the input table should have each OTU present only once. The OTUs table I got using Qiime has OTUs ID and then through taxonomy assignment I have taxonomies assigned to each OTU ID. In some cases, different OTUs ID have the same taxonomy assignment. Shall I group the same taxonomy before I submit the data? I have already run masalin analysis on my dataset having normalized the initial OTU table (I have not grouped OTU that have the same taxonomy assignment).
>  I reported to you a while ago that I had a question on the output file. The output I got is for example Firmicutes|Clostridia|Clostridiales|Clostridiaceae|s_14.  I couldn't understand what the numbers assigned at the end the taxonomies mean. You have replied to me mentioning that masalin should not add any numbers at the end. I was wondering whether I shall change the format of the input data.
> I am writing a study and I am citing Masalin as one of the tools I used in my analysis. However, I am not sure how to graphically represent the output data.
>
> I would appreciate if you could reply to me and clarify these issues. I would also like to thank you in advance for your time and assistance.
>
> Many thanks,
> Maria Glymenaki
